title: KV-PRM: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via KV-Cache Transfer for Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2607.09153v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have been proven to be highly effective in guiding test-time scaling (TTS) methods, which significantly boost the capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems. However, existing PRMs are text-based: they re-encode the entire trajectory text from scratch. In long multi-agent rollouts, the scoring cost, growing quadratically with respect to sequence length L, creates a severe computational bottleneck, severely limiting PRMs' application in long-context scenarios. To resolve this, we introduce KV-PRM, a highly efficient process reward model that eliminates the heavy text re-encoding by directly reading the KV cache produced naturally during the LLM's generation phase. By processing a single "verify token" against the pre-existing KV cache, KV-PRM reduces the scoring cost from O(L^2) to O(L). translated_title: KV-PRM：通过KV缓存传递实现多智能体测试时扩展的高效过程奖励建模
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型已被证明在指导测试时扩展（TTS）方法方面非常有效，可显著提升基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的能力。然而，现有的过程奖励模型是基于文本的：它们需要从头开始对整个轨迹文本进行重新编码。在较长的多智能体轨迹展开中，评分成本随序列长度L呈二次方增长，形成了严重的计算瓶颈，极大限制了过程奖励模型在长上下文场景中的应用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了KV-PRM，一种高效的过程奖励模型，它通过直接读取大语言模型在生成阶段自然产生的KV缓存，消除了繁重的文本重新编码过程。通过针对已有的KV缓存处理单个“验证token”，KV-PRM将评分成本从O(L²)降低到O(L)。我们正式证明KV缓存包含严格大于文本的信息容量，并且更加高效……
tldr: KV-PRM通过直接读取大语言模型生成阶段产生的KV缓存来替代从头重新编码轨迹文本，将过程奖励模型的评分成本从O(L²)降至O(L)，实现了多智能体测试时扩展中的高效奖励评分。
en_tdlr: KV-PRM eliminates costly text re-encoding by directly reading the KV cache generated during LLM inference, reducing process reward scoring cost from O(L²) to O(L) for efficient multi-agent test-time scaling.
